messages.subject: Multiple Users Problems
parts: Hi, I’m using Shinyapps.io free tier.  When launching the application simultaneously from two different devices, I got this error message: “ERROR: not default HTML output file defined; please call HTMLSetFile() to set it”.  I read that the free tier can allow for multiple users.  Please help.  Thanks!
